record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale history embeddings by a deterministic training-frequency feature: clamp((median_positive_item_count/max(item_count,1))^0.10,0.8,1.2), with padding remaining zero. This tests gentler frequency correction than the previously regressing exponent 0.25. Derive counts solely from training interactions and checkpoint the scales for identical inference. Preserve learned embedding design, GRU topology, readout, candidate embeddings, loss and optimizer.
